_readme: Projects excluded from the FULL lint lane (npm run lint:all), which is otherwise strict and green. This is deliberately NOT the affected lane's knownUnstableProjects list: that one quarantines ~40 projects for the affected lane, and pointing lint:all at it would collapse full-lane coverage to almost nothing. Only projects that actually fail strict lint today belong here, each with the finding that owns paying it down. tests/invariants/lint-quarantine-ssot.spec.ts caps the size so this cannot quietly become 'lint nothing'.
